blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video question answering under tight frame budgets requires preserving localized motion and event order, yet current video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reduce comprehension to static multi-image reasoning by discarding unselected frames and encoding keyframes independently: (1) Spatially, whole-frame pooling dilutes small moving targets into static backgrounds; (2) Temporally, dropping intermediate frames or averaging tokens erases inter-frame motion, confusing direction, speed, and order. We propose VIVID (Visual Inter-frame Variations and Individual Dynamics), which moves beyond static snapshots like human vision: keyframes capture core states while inter-frame Patch Diffs preserve neighboring changes within $K_f$ keyframes. Autonomous Delta-Driven Keyframe Planning (ADKP) selects anchors from a $3\text{ fps}$ pool and feeds surrounding patch differences into Dual-Road Change Memory (DRCM), forming Dynamic Tokens at zero extra anchor tokens alongside a camera-stabilized Active Motion Region of Interest (ROI) and chronological Entity State Chains. Adding $0.22\%$ trainable parameters to a frozen $27\text{B}$ backbone, VIVID-Small ($50$ examples, $\sim 1.5$ GPU hours) beats all eleven baselines in overall accuracy across $8,083$ questions and trails only VIVID-Large ($3,600$ examples), which leads on MotionBench, Video-MME, and TempCompass.
blocks.zh: 在紧凑的框架预算下回答视频问题需要保留局部运动和事件顺序,然而目前的视频多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)却通过独立丢弃未选择的框架和编码密钥框架来降低对静态多图像推理的理解: (1)在空间上,全帧集合会稀释小移动目标入静态背景; (2)暂时地,抛出中间相框或平均相标会抹去相框间运动,使方向,速度,秩序混乱. 我们提出VIVID(视觉跨框架变化和个人动态),它超越了像人类视觉那样的静态快照:键框捕捉到核心状态,而相框Patch Diffs在$K_f$键框内保存相邻的变化. 自主 Delta-Driven 密钥帧规划(ADKP)从 3\text{ fps}$ 池中选择主锚,并将周围的补丁差异反馈到双路变化内存(DRCM)中,与相机稳定的活动兴趣区(ROI)和时间顺序实体国链一起以零额外锚值组成动态托肯斯. VIVID-Small(50美元的例子,1.5美元GPU小时)将0.22美元可训练参数加到一个被冻结的27\text{B}$的主干线上,在8,083美元的问题中以总体准确度击败了所有11个基线,并且只有VIVID-Large(3,600美元的例子),这导致了Motion Bench、Video-MME和TempCompass。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video understanding differs fundamentally from image recognition because meaning resides in how visual entities and their states evolve across frames [ 7 , 42 , 2 , 20 ] .
However, current video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) largely reduce video comprehension to static multi image reasoning : their vision encoders process each frame independently as a static image [ 6 , 44 , 40 , 16 , 35 , 36 , 41 , 28 ] or condense static features into compressed memory and summary representations [ 39 , 13 , 37 , 38 , 31 , 25 , 30 , 27 , 11 ] , forcing the language model to guess inter frame transitions implicitly.
As shown in Fig. 1 , this static paradigm suffers from dual bottlenecks in space and time :

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early ViT pruning merges similar tokens (ToMe [ 3 ] , vid-TLDR [ 8 ] ) or drops low attention tokens (FastV [ 6 ] , VisionZip [ 44 ] , LLaVA-PruMerge [ 33 ] ).
Recent video MLLMs extend reduction across frames: DyCoke [ 40 ] merges temporal groups, PruneVid [ 16 ] clusters static and dynamic tokens, HoliTom [ 35 ] performs spatio temporal merging, FastVID [ 36 ] segments clips by whole frame similarity, EarlyTom [ 41 ] compresses spatial tokens early, and ST-SimDiff [ 28 ] balances similarity prototypes with temporal difference token selection.
Complementing selection and pruning, VIVID learns to inject surrounding Patch Diffs directly into anchor embeddings as Dynamic Tokens while guiding ADKP with learned gates and top 15 % 15\% local changes.
blocks.zh:

近期的视频MLLMs跨帧延伸还原: DyCoke [40] 合并了时间组,PruneVid [16] 集群静态和动态符号,HoliTom [35] 执行时段并排,FastVID [36] 片段片段按整个帧相似性进行剪接,EarlyTom [41] 压缩空间符号早期,ST-SimDiff [28] 平衡了类似性原型与时间差符号选择.
在补充选择和穿行的同时,VIVID学会了将周围的Patch Diffs直接注入锚地嵌入为动态托肯斯,同时用已学到的门来引导ADKP,以及前15%的 15+Q 本地变化.

blocks.en:
To scale video MLLMs to multi minute benchmarks [ 29 , 43 , 45 ] , long video methods condense streams into feature slots or text summaries: MovieChat [ 39 ] , MA-LMM [ 13 ] , Chat-UniVi [ 18 ] , LLaMA-VID [ 23 ] , LongVU [ 37 ] , Video-XL [ 38 ] , Oryx [ 26 ] , ProtoKV [ 30 ] , and Vista [ 27 ] pool historical frames into compressed slots or prototypes, whereas VideoLLM-online [ 5 ] , VideoStreaming [ 31 ] , Goldfish [ 1 ] , VideoChat-Online [ 17 ] , VideoMind [ 25 ] , and VideoStir [ 11 ] generate clip captions or retrieve events.
To preserve fine grained per object order alongside compact memory, VIVID pairs Dynamic Tokens with structured per entity Entity State Chains .

为保留每个对象顺序和紧凑内存的精细颗粒,VIVID配对了每个实体实体国家链的结构化动态托肯.

blocks.en:
Prior diagnostic studies [ 4 , 19 ] demonstrate that video language models frequently rely on single frame appearance cues rather than inter frame transitions, motivating dedicated temporal and motion benchmarks [ 21 , 24 , 22 , 9 , 34 , 14 ] .
Whereas LoRA [ 15 ] provides parameter efficient adaptation and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) [ 32 ] incorporates a reference policy likelihood term, VIVID supervises adaptation with dense patch difference reconstruction and a reference free option preference margin loss.

LoRA[15]提供了参数高效的适应和直接优惠优化(DPO)[32]包含一个参考政策可能性术语,VIVID则以密集的补丁差重建以及参考自由选项优惠幅度损失来监督适应.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
On MotionBench ( Tab. 1 ), nearly all similarity based compression and memory baselines score below static uniform sampling on Moving Objects and Action Order : whole frame cosine pooling treats small foreground motions against large static backgrounds as redundant, while cross frame merging averages moving object patches into surrounding background context.
By weighting local patch differences, cropping a camera stabilized Active Motion ROI , and injecting surrounding candidate changes into Dynamic Tokens at zero extra anchor token cost, VIVID-Small and VIVID-Large claim the top two positions in overall accuracy and across all five object and action motion categories (tying uniform sampling for second on Action Order ), while keeping uniform frame spacing under global camera pans preserves velocity cues on Camera Motion .
blocks.zh:
在Motion Bench (Tab. 1)上,几乎所有基于相似性的压缩和内存基线的得分都低于静态统一采样在"移动对象和动作顺序"上:全帧余弦集合将大型静态背景的小型前缘运动视为多余,而跨帧将平均移动对象补丁合并到周围背景.
VIVID-Small和VIVID-Large通过加权局部补丁差异,裁剪相机稳定了活性运动ROI,并以零额外锚标成本将周围候选人变化注入动态托肯斯,在整体精确度和所有五个物体和行动运动类别(将统一取样作为第二行动顺序)中,VIVID-Small和VIVID-Large要求最高两个位置,同时在全球相机平板下保持统一帧间隔,保留相机运动上的速度提示。

blocks.en:
On untrimmed multi scene videos ( Tabs. 2 and S1 ), compressing up to 96 96 candidates into eight slots challenges merging and pruning methods on 30 ​ – ​ 60 ​ min 30\text{--}60\,\mathrm{min} videos because brief intra scene actions are averaged across shot boundaries, while coarse clip captions blend distinct entities across cuts.
Downweighting hard shot cuts prevents ADKP from wasting slots on scene transitions, neighboring same scene candidate frames supply accurate motion residuals for Dynamic Tokens , and working memory Entity State Chains preserve canonical entity identities across scenes, enabling VIVID-Small and VIVID-Large to take second and first places across all duration splits ( Tab. 2 ) and lead or tie for first in nine of twelve task categories ( Tab. S1 ), especially on Temporal Reasoning and Counting .
blocks.zh:
在未剪接的多场景视频(Tabs. 2和S1)上,将多达96名候选人压缩到8个档次的挑战中,
减重的硬镜头切口可以防止ADKP在场景过渡上浪费空档,相邻的同场景候选框架为Dynamic Tokens提供准确的运动余力,工作记忆实体国家链保存了跨场景的犬科实体身份,使得VIVID-Small和VIVID-Large能够在所有时间段分出第二名和第一名(Tab. 2),并在12个任务类别(Tab. S1)中的9个类别(特别是Timoral Reasoning and Counting)中占据第一名或第一名。

blocks.en:
Tab. 2 exposes the gap between static recognition and temporal state reasoning: while all methods saturate on single frame Action , token pruning and slot merging drop noticeably on Speed , Direction , and Attribute Change because cross frame pooling smooths out displacement magnitude and progressive drift.
Providing explicit anchor timestamps while transforming static anchors into surrounding frame Dynamic Tokens alongside chronological Entity State Chains retains both instantaneous speed and gradual attribute evolution, allowing VIVID-Small to match or surpass heavily trained baselines from 50 50 examples and VIVID-Large to lead overall accuracy, Speed , and Attribute Change .
blocks.zh:
Tab. 2 揭示了静态识别和时间状态推理之间的差距:虽然所有方法都饱和于单帧动作上,
提供明确的锚地时间戳,同时将静态锚地转换成周围框架的动态托肯,同时保留瞬时速度和逐渐的属性演化,使VIVID-Small能够匹配或超过50个实例和VIVID-Large中训练有素的基线,从而导致总体准确性、速度和属性变化。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We identify the spatial and temporal bottlenecks that arise when video MLLMs reduce video understanding to static multi image reasoning and propose VIVID to move beyond isolated snapshots while keeping all 27 ​ B 27\,\mathrm{B} backbone weights frozen and adding only 0.22 % 0.22\% trainable parameters.
Coupling Autonomous Delta Driven Keyframe Planning (ADKP) with Dual Road Change Memory (DRCM) folds neighboring frame Patch Diffs into Dynamic Tokens at zero extra anchor tokens alongside camera stabilized Active Motion ROIs and reusable video level Entity State Chains whose construction cost amortizes across multi query workloads.
Evaluations across 8,083 8{,}083 questions on MotionBench, Video-MME, and TempCompass confirm that VIVID surpasses ten published baselines and static uniform sampling in overall accuracy from just 50 50 calibration examples ( VIVID-Small ) and achieves the highest overall accuracy on every benchmark at 3,600 3{,}600 clips ( VIVID-Large ), establishing localized change representations and chronological entity state memory as an effective paradigm for resource efficient video reasoning under tight frame budgets.
blocks.zh:
我们确定当视频 MLLMs 将视频理解降低为静态多图像推理时会出现的空间和时间瓶颈,并提议VIVID 超越孤立的快照,同时保留所有27 B 27\,\mathrm{B}主干重被冻结并只添加0.22%的可训练参数.
合并自治 Delta Driven Keyframe Planning (ADKP) 具有双路变化内存(DRCM)的相邻框架 Patch Diffs 以零个额外锚地符号与相机一起折叠成 Dynamic Tokens 并稳定活性运动ROIs和可再使用的视频级实体国链,其建造成本通过多问工作量摊还.
对关于Motion Bench、Video-MME和TempCompass的8 083 8{、}083个问题的评价证实,VIVID从50个校准例子(VIVID-Small)中总体准确性超过了10个公布的基线和静态统一抽样,并在每个基准上达到最高的总体准确度,为3 600 3{、}600个剪辑(VIVID-Large),将局部变化表示和时间顺序实体状态记忆确定为在严格框架预算下资源高效视频推理的有效范例。
